Definition: from G3956 and G3753; every when, i.e. at all times:--alway(-s), ever(-more).
BiblicalUsage: Pantote means always, at all times. Rejoice evermore, says Paul to the Thessalonians, and to the Corinthians he says be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that always is the shape of the Christian life: rejoicing always, abounding always, because the Lord's work is never finished and neither is His faithfulness.
